verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an LLM inference engine, so multi-GPU distribution is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence shows tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism across GPUs. The documentation centres on single-device SSD expert streaming and on-device apps, and the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
